ENDFORM.                    " R_ASSIGN_FIELD_FIELD_TO_FIELD

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_ASSIGN_FIELD_BIT_TO_FIELD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Attribute eines Dynprofeldes in interner Darstellung dem       *
*       elementaren Dynprofeld in ext. Darstellung zuordnen            *
*       Attributzuordnungen Bit  -> Feld                               *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_ASSIGN_FIELD_BIT_TO_FIELD
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.
